title: CAST Live scan
invalid: This link is not valid. Ask your organiser for a new one.
no_camera: This browser cannot use the camera. Open the link in Safari (iPhone) or Chrome (Android).
camera_denied: Camera access was refused. Allow the camera for this site in your browser settings, then reload.
consent_1: You will film one object. The video is sent to {name} to make a 3D model.
consent_2: Only film objects you are allowed to record. Keep people out of the picture.
consent_check: I am allowed to film this object
mode_object: An object I can pick up
check_light: Even light: shade or a cloudy sky. No direct sun, no flash.
check_surface: Put it on a plain surface that is a different colour from the object.
check_gloves: Wear gloves (blue or purple are best) when you turn the object over.
check_space: Make sure you can walk all the way round it.
check_close: Hold the phone close, so the object fills most of the screen.
check_markers: If you have the printed marker card, put it on the ground next to the object.
frame_guide: Get close: fill this box with the object
rec_hint_object_1: Walk slowly all the way round. Keep the whole object in view.
rec_hint_object_2: Walk round again to film the other side.
rec_hint_insitu_1: Walk slowly all the way round, holding the phone low.
rec_hint_insitu_2: Walk round again, holding the phone higher and pointing down.
rec_round_done: I've gone all the way round
flip_body: Keep recording. Turn the object over gently. You can put the phone down if you need both hands.
pass1_done_body: Keep recording. Now hold the phone higher, point it down at the object, and walk round once more.
warn_lost: Lost track: go back a little, slowly
live_busy: No live view: the server is busy making another model. Recording works as normal
warn_screen: Keep the screen on and this page open.
upload_body: Keep this page open until sending is done.
upload_offline: No connection. The video is saved on this phone and will be sent when you are back online. Open this page again then.
status_checked: The video is good. It is being made into a 3D model (this takes several minutes). You can close this page.
status_done: The 3D model is ready. Thank you!
status_model_failed: The video arrived, but a 3D model could not be made: {error}
leave_warning: A recording is still being sent. Leave anyway?
